DataManager¶

Implemented internally with numpy arrays, the DataManager is the data structure that stores all collected data by workflow data collect. After running workflow data collect, a compiled DataManager is stored at data/stage_name.dm. DataManager (legacy alias: Data_Manager) objects provide useful utility for filtering and sorting collected data by job variables. See the below examples and documentation for more info on this utility.

from snap_workflow import DataManager

# Load in DataManager with:
#    Job variables: N(int), eta(float), gamma(float)
#    Collected data: t, bonds (both numpy arrays)
dm = DataManager("path/to/data_manager.pkl")


#Filter by variable comparison
etas = dm["eta"] #All eta instances (numpy array)
dm_e = dm[etas > 0.05]


#Filter by multiple comparisons
gammas = dm["gammas"]
dm_eg = dm_e[gammas > 1.5]
    #Or equivalently
dm_eg = dm[etas > 0.05, gammas > 1.5]


#Split Data_Manager via unique instances of a variable
Ns = dm["N"]
unique_Ns = dm.unique("N") #Unique instances (numpy array)
for N in unique_Ns:
    dm_N = dm[Ns == N]
    ...

#Or equivalently
Ns,dm_Ns = dm.split("N")
for N,dm_N in zip(matrices,dm_Ns):
    ...


#Iterate through each instance
for data in dm:
    eta = data["eta"] #float
    gamma = data["gamma"] #float
    N = data["N"] #int

    t = data["t"] #numpy array
    bonds = data["bonds"] #numpy array

    ...
